I think we could modernize this a bit by tightening the scope of the try/catch blocks like isolating the mapper call and handling per-instance failures separately, or even moving toward a small helper that returns std::optional/std::expected instead of relying on exceptions in the main flow. But I don’t have a strong preference here, both approaches seem reasonable depending on what style we want to standardize on.

@patrick@stwcx.xyz - do you have any guidance or preference for how best we should handle this pattern going forward since this pattern would probably repeat alot ?
Reducing the scope of try-catch block to only mapper call.
typo
Done
This comment seems redundant since there is already a trace that conveys the exact same message below.
Done
drop `TCPTransportDiscovery::discovery: `
Done
drop this , and use `auto` below
When you declare a variable using auto inside a try block, that variable's scope is confined to the try block only and cannot be accessed outside of it.
wouldn't this crash too ?
Acknowledged
Consider using warning or error here instead of info, since it's logging an exception.

This exception is expected during system boot when no SPDM TCP endpoints are available. The daemon handles this condition gracefully and continues operation, so logging it at info level is intentional.
We already have similar error traces below in utils.hpp at lines 46 & 50.Can we remove it?
Done

Can you please check commit, https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/spdm/+/80262/23/requester/utils/mapper.cpp

Now it's handled in that function itself, so empty response needs to be handled
It is better to handle exceptions at the caller level where you have more context about what to do.
I agree with archana, I dont think its a good practice to mask exceptions in a util function.Its good to leave it to the caller to decide how can they handle them.
Should this be treated as an error or warning?. Name in typed arg is not matching with log level --> info(..{ERROR})
Acknowledged
This is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase which uses it at namespace scope in .cpp

I have added PHOSPHOR_LOG2_USING in the function scope so that unnecessary importing of logging functions into the namespace of the other files which include utils.hpp can be avoided. I hope this is acceptable.

Sorry I wasn't super responsive on this.  I would prefer we get this fixed in the mapper utility and was working on https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/sdbusplus/+/89540 in order to give us some machinery that we need to make that happen.  I'll do the refactoring necessary there.

I don't really understand the conditions when we need to do this.  I get we are trying to be "safe" but it means we're also silently hiding errors in, as a primary culprit, entity-manager.  I think that just makes debug more difficult rather than a hard-failure in, hopefully, the early testing.

It's relatively easy to get an entity-manager config surfaced in QEMU and if our service is crashing we can easily catch that in Robot.  Detecting the missing SPDM interface is a much harder problem.
